results.content: The first international break of the 2026-27 men's football season will last a week longer than it usually does, with the traditional October break now scrapped. They have all consisted of two-week gaps in the season calendar that take place in March, June, September, October and November. But instead, there will now be a three-week gap for international fixtures across late September and early October, where countries will play four international matches instead of two.
